# SCARA Studio 2.9.3

- Expanded Settings → Mechanics with editable joint soft limits, geometry, transmission settings, measured pulse calibration, and TCP/OPR reference height.
- Updated Q2/Z calibrated travel to 0–150 mm for 0–675000 pulses (4500 pulses/mm).
- Manual, Point-to-Point and Path Following share one Robot Model; use simulation when PLC is disconnected and hardware control when connected.
- Fixed offline Path Following to interpolate the full joint-space path continuously without restarting easing at every waypoint; PLC QD75 motion remains unchanged.
- Removed the temporary Mechanics stick-diagram reference images.
- Preserved existing Windows installer and UPDATE VERSION channel. Verify on the real robot before use.
